title: Options: explicit and strict
requirements: Emphasize the two file-level directives independently. They already exist in Program.vb; do not claim an absent .vbproj was supplied.
The displayed excerpt must be the literal Program.vb lines 7–8; store an unmodified .vb excerpt alongside the editable rendering.
Required focus sequence: Option Explicit On → Option Strict On.
Keep code and explanatory annotations in separate layers. Highlighting must not replace or remove tokens; soft visual wrapping is allowed without inserting source newlines.
Provide a clean whole-excerpt state and a highlighted teaching state. For a long excerpt, use a measured scroll/pagination sequence with all lines represented, never unreadably small text.
beats: 2–8 s: move through the listed focus targets in source order, allowing at least one second per distinct target.
8–10 s or extended duration: finish on a readable summary highlight.
checks: Canonical excerpt text equals Program.vb lines 7–8, byte-normalized only for newline comparison.
All focus tokens appear in the visual and in the correct source context.
Partial control structures are labeled excerpt in the editorial metadata, not silently “fixed” with invented code.
No smart quotes, hidden truncation, wrong VB token colors, or horizontally clipped underscores/colons.
copy:
Option Explicit On
Option Strict On
